summary.text: Donna Bailey is a Democratic state senator from Maine Senate District 31 who took office on December 1, 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney who lives in Saco, she served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2016 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Donna Bailey lives in Saco, Maine, and graduated from Berlin High School in 1979.
She earned a degree in European history from Bates College in 1983 and a law degree from the University of Maine in 1986.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney with Maine Title Company, and she served on the Saco Planning Board and the Zoning Board of Appeals.
Bailey represented House District 14 from 2016 to 2020 before her election to the Senate.
